title: Tectonic Shift — Key/Lock Inversion — The Earthquake

key_lock.old_paradigm: We need the monkey's key. We wait. We ask. We're locked out.
key_lock.new_paradigm: We BRING our lock. SSH = we generate the lock (public key), point it at the server. The server never gives us its key — we give it our lock.
key_lock.applied: //primals.eco/ IS the inverted lock. We don't need hud.primals.eco to give us access. We route THROUGH the domain that already accepts our lock.
key_lock.principle: You can't unlock yourself. You can't open it. You just find and point.
key_lock.monkey: CF dashboard holds the DNS key. Wrangler OAuth doesn't even OFFER DNS as a scope. The key isn't withheld — it doesn't exist in this keyring.

waiting_not_zk.old_paradigm: Push to GitHub, wait for CF to batch-bake, check if it deployed, retry.
waiting_not_zk.new_paradigm: We have it ready. They come to us. We lead, they follow. The organism is more reflexive than the infrastructure.
waiting_not_zk.applied: wrangler pages deploy --branch main = instant. No batch queue. Baker sends cookies hot.
waiting_not_zk.principle: Waiting is not zero-knowledge. If you wait, you're admitting dependency on the monkey's schedule.

frozen_layers.old_paradigm: Impact = collision between moving things. If nothing moves, nothing happens.
frozen_layers.new_paradigm: Impact includes STUCK, PRESSURE, FROZEN, PINNED. The absence of motion IS a signal. Frozen layers need ooze.

four_states.stuck: Element hasn't moved in N frames. Friction > force. Needs lubricant.
four_states.pressure: Two elements pushing but not yielding. Potential building with no release. Eventually: earthquake.
four_states.frozen: Element SHOULD move (has velocity source) but position unchanged. Ice. Needs heat.
four_states.pinned: User intentionally fixed it. It RESISTS movement. Anchor, not error.

frozen_layers.the_ooze: Heat from impacts reduces friction at stuck interfaces. Sound leaks through gaps between layers. Color flashes mark where gas exchange happens. The organism lubricates itself through collision.

plate_tectonics.thesis: Each helix layer is a tectonic plate. They move relative to each other. The Klein fold is the transform boundary where everything slides past.

transform.mechanism: Counter-rotating layers slide past each other
transform.helix_mapping: Even CW + Odd CCW pairs = net zero rotation = STRAIGHT gyroscopic
transform.analog: San Andreas fault. The fold. Klein surface.

subduction.mechanism: Both layers rotate same direction (CW). One slides under.
subduction.helix_mapping: Same-direction pairs = BEND in the helix
subduction.analog: Pacific plate under North American. Deep trench. Volcanoes behind.

divergence.mechanism: Both layers rotate same direction (CCW). Pulling apart.
divergence.helix_mapping: Same-direction pairs = GAP opening in the helix
divergence.analog: Mid-Atlantic Ridge. New material emerges from below.

earthquake.trigger: Pressure builds at stuck interfaces. When potential exceeds threshold ? sudden release ? earthquake = massive impact event
earthquake.what_shifted: Oct 24 growth peak (1,086 refs) = volcanic eruption. 608 new files deployed at once = tectonic shift. The plates moved.
earthquake.aftershocks: baker/cookie fix, DNS lock discovery, proxy 429, domain reactivation — all aftershocks of the main quake

sensing_the_unsensable.principle: We can't fix what we can't sense. The frozen/stuck/pressure states were INVISIBLE until now.

added_to_impact_js.positionHistory: Circular buffer of 90 frames (~1.5s) per body
added_to_impact_js.frozen_vs_stuck: Frozen = SHOULD move but doesn't (orbit, pendulum). Stuck = naturally stationary (chroma dots). Different diagnosis.
added_to_impact_js.pressure_detection: Pair potential > 0.01 with no recent impact = building pressure
added_to_impact_js.pinned_detection: SVG has .null-pinned class = user intentionally anchored it
added_to_impact_js.plate_detection: Helix layer pairs classified as transform/subduction/divergence

tectonic_sounds.tectonic_shift: Subsonic rumble (sine, 40Hz, 3s decay) — the deep earthquake

the_shift.before: HUD was a photograph. Scripts returned 404. Layers frozen. No collision sense. No tectonic sense.
the_shift.after: HUD is alive at primals.eco. 7 scripts execute. Impact senses collision + stuck + pressure + frozen. Plates classified. Sound + heat + color at every interface.
the_shift.whats_moving: The earthquake IS the growth. 10,438 files. 1,474 unnamed braids. 608 new files deployed in one push. The plates shifted OVER and UNDER and PAST the Klein face.
